sloka: इमानि मुख पद्मानि नियतम् मत्त षट्पदाः ।अम्बुजानि इव फुल्लानि प्रार्थयन्ति पुनः पुनः ॥५-९-३९॥
transliteration: imāni mukha padmāni niyatam matta ṣaṭpadāḥ ।ambujāni iva phullāni prārthayanti punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-9-39॥

translations.english: The intoxicated bees would again and again long to enjoy these beautiful faces which were like blooming lotuses.
